console.name: chaos
console.title: Chaos
console.description: The chaos rules and their report

enabled.description: Whether chaos is switched on: with profile dev or camel.chaos.enabled=true, never with profile prod

reason.description: Why chaos is off (only when it is off)

id.description: The id of the rule, such as r1

version.description: The version of the rule: 1 when added, one more each time it is changed

rule.description: The rule in its one-line text form

state.description: The state of the rule: active or ended

hooks.description: Where the rule fires: send, poll, entry or step

matches.description: The sends, polls, exchanges or steps the target of the rule matched

fired.description: The faults the rule fired, per hook

skipped.description: The faults that did nothing, as the rule fired at a message or an endpoint it cannot change

endsIn.description: The milliseconds until an active rule ends

expectation.description: The expectation of the rule (expect= and within=) and its outcome, when it has one

rules.description: The current rules (not the removed or replaced ones; only when chaos is on)

report.description: The report: verdict, final, seed, seedGiven, lost, reasons, all rules with the removed and replaced ones, and the counts per route (only when chaos is on)
